metadata.name: Query Stability Benchmark
metadata.phase_1_1_note: Re-designated as DEV/DIAGNOSTIC in Phase 1.1 Sub-stage B. This 160-query benchmark was co-designed with the Phase 1 rule engine, so its accuracy figures are not a valid generalization measure. It must not be treated as a held-out evaluation source. The independent evaluation sets (heldout, final_test) remain untouched.
